resources.string: Standard guitar 8vb Treble Staff with automatic ledger lines. The gold column highlights the active target note.
Practice in 7 Major Keys (C, G, D, A, E, F, Bb) across 5 guitar neck positions (OPEN, POS 2, 5, 7, 9) and 24 graded etudes.

Tap the matching string & fret directly on the 6-string rosewood guitar neck to sight-read each note. Etude mode shows guided fretboard hints; Quiz mode hides hints for pure sight-reading; Flow mode auto-advances with the tempo click.
Tap PLAY to hear the 2-bar etude at the selected BPM, or tap SOUND / MUTED in the top bar to toggle real-time guitar synthesis.
